summary: This document is a pre-registered hypothesis card (P11) proposing that caspase-3 (effector/CPP32) loss-of-function or pharmacologic block abolishes FOXO4-DRI senescent-cell kill at least as completely as it abolishes navitoclax kill on matched senescent cultures. The claim is currently UNKNOWN/PREDICTION status — no matched caspase-3 LOF × FOXO4-DRI vs navitoclax head-to-head experiment has been run. The document situates this as the terminal effector gate downstream of previously characterized nodes (Bax, apoptosome/caspase-9, caspase-8) and explicitly flags that prior literature (PMID 28340339, 41625068, 26711051, 8934524) does not satisfy the pre-registered abolish criterion.

content_blocks.title: Claim / Hypothesis Statement
content_blocks.content: On a matched senescent culture, caspase-3 (effector/CPP32) loss-of-function (or pharmacologic caspase-3–selective block) abolishes FOXO4-DRI senescent-cell kill at least as completely as it abolishes navitoclax kill. Pre-registered criterion: relative kill loss_FOXO4 ≥ relative kill loss_navitoclax, with each arm showing ≥20% relative kill loss vs the same senolytic on control genotype/vehicle. Status: PREDICTION — not yet experimentally tested.

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale / Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: FOXO4-DRI enters via FOXO4–p53 axis; navitoclax enters via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w. Both may converge on caspase-3 effector execution, or FOXO4-DRI may retain partial caspase-3-independent routes while navitoclax is abolished (or vice versa). This is framed as the terminal effector node downstream of Bax (P7/P8), apoptosome/caspase-9 (P9), and caspase-8 (P10). Endothelial FOXO4-DRI work (PMID 41625068) frames a p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3 cascade but does not include a caspase-3 LOF vs navitoclax matched abolish panel.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art Summary
content_blocks.content:
Four key references are cited:
1. PMID 28340339 (Baar 2017, Cell) — FOXO4-DRI perturbs FOXO4–p53 → senescent-cell apoptosis; no caspase-3 LOF arm.
2. PMID 41625068 (2025, Front. Bioeng.) — endothelial FOXO4-DRI framed via p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3 cascade; not a caspase-3 LOF vs navitoclax H2H.
3. PMID 26711051 (Zhu 2016, Aging Cell) — navitoclax (ABT-263) senolytic via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w; cell-type restricted.
4. PMID 8934524 (Kuida 1996, Nature) — CPP32/caspase-3–deficient mice show decreased developmental apoptosis; effector prior, not a FOXO4-DRI SC matched panel.
Soft-complete search: FOXO4-DRI ∩ (caspase-3|CPP32) ∩ (LOF|epistasis|navitoclax) = 0 hits; sole FOXO4-DRI ∩ caspase-3 hit = 41625068 (cascade framing only).

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations / Epistemic Discipline
content_blocks.content:
1. P5–P10 (Bax/residual/apoptosome/caspase-8 cards) do NOT prove P11 — none ran caspase-3 LOF; empty soft-complete ≠ demonstrated ≥ equal abolish.
2. Caspase-3 cascade framing (PMID 41625068) ≠ caspase-3 genetic necessity — implicates caspase-3 without LOF arm or navitoclax-matched abolish.
3. Kuida (PMID 8934524) ≠ FOXO4-DRI panel — classical effector prior is not a senolytic H2H; navitoclax-insensitive SC types confound matched culture choice.

content_blocks.title: Ablation / Refutation Criteria
content_blocks.content:
Ablation: Removing the matched caspase-3 LOF H2H panel, or removing the ≥ equal-abolish quantitative contrast, or conflating P5–P10 framing with caspase-3 epistasis would each invalidate the claim.
Refutation criterion: On the pre-registered matched panel, FOXO4-DRI kill largely survives caspase-3 LOF/block while navitoclax kill is abolished, OR relative kill loss_FOXO4 is below relative kill loss_navitoclax outside the pre-registered ≥ equal band — indicating pathway-sparing/caspase-3-independent FOXO4-DRI execution.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Assay Design (Ask a Human)
content_blocks.content: Lock one senescent system sensitive to both senolytics (FOXO4-DRI and navitoclax). Apply caspase-3 LOF (genetic KO/KD) vs pharmacologic caspase-3–selective block tool. Measure viability + caspase readout in matched culture. Do not treat P5–P10 as proof. No dosing values to be invented. Pre-specify α and N before running.

key_findings: P11 is a PREDICTION/UNKNOWN — no matched caspase-3 LOF × FOXO4-DRI vs navitoclax head-to-head experiment has been performed (execution_status = NOT_RUN).

Soft-complete literature search found zero hits for FOXO4-DRI ∩ (caspase-3|CPP32) ∩ (LOF|epistasis|navitoclax); sole FOXO4-DRI ∩ caspase-3 hit (PMID 41625068) provides cascade framing only, not genetic necessity.
Pre-registered threshold: relative kill loss_FOXO4 ≥ relative kill loss_navitoclax, each arm ≥20% relative kill loss vs control, on the same matched senescent culture.
Competing/falsifier outcome explicitly defined: FOXO4-DRI kill survives caspase-3 LOF while navitoclax is abolished → caspase-3-independent FOXO4-DRI execution.

Four literature anchors established: FOXO4–p53 entry (PMID 28340339), p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3 cascade framing (PMID 41625068), navitoclax Bcl-2-family senolytic (PMID 26711051), caspase-3 KO effector prior (PMID 8934524) — none satisfy the matched abolish criterion.
Estimated time-to-refute: 4 weeks; kill_cost_tier = 1 (low cost); ip_class = momp-execution-gate.

TRL assessment: TRL 1 — concept/hypothesis only; no experimental data generated for this specific claim; all supporting evidence is literature-derived and explicitly flagged as insufficient to prove the hypothesis.
